lessons.zhMechanism: 气力全队共享，内力各自消耗。青锋一式可为队友减费。
lessons.enMechanism: AP is shared; MP is personal. Edge cuts the next ally card's AP cost.

lessons.zhMechanism: 先看敌方意图，再叠护甲。护甲先挡伤害，剩余伤害扣气血。
lessons.enMechanism: Read enemy intent, then gain Armor. Armor absorbs damage before HP.

lessons.zhMechanism: 首牌定阵赏；四张不同主角法术牌完成任务并重放，每回合至多一次。
lessons.enMechanism: First card sets the reward. Four different Hero spells replay; one task per round.

lessons.zhMechanism: 队伍首张主动牌触发冲锋；末张刀客牌在回合末收招。
lessons.enMechanism: Open with a Blade card for its Opener; end with one for its Finisher.

lessons.zhMechanism: 先积气势、给敌人破绽，再接攻击牌提高伤害。
lessons.enMechanism: Build Momentum and apply Vulnerability, then follow with attacks.

lessons.zhMechanism: 反应牌等敌人行动触发；收招看最后主动牌，重放不改它。
lessons.enMechanism: Reactions wait for enemy actions. Replays do not change your Finisher.

lessons.zhMechanism: 护甲挡伤害，格挡按次数触发。叠好防护，再让敌人进攻。
lessons.enMechanism: Armor absorbs damage; Block uses charges. Prepare, then face an attack.

lessons.zhMechanism: 先叠护甲，再用盾击；护甲越多，这类攻击越强。
lessons.enMechanism: Build Armor before shield attacks: more Armor means more damage.

lessons.zhMechanism: 每张药方牌首次主动使用多耗1气力，药方持续本场战斗。
lessons.enMechanism: Each Prescription costs +1 AP on its first active play; it lasts this battle.

lessons.zhMechanism: 先挂流血、中毒或灼烧，再毒爆，让持续伤害立即结算。
lessons.enMechanism: Apply Bleed, Poison or Burn, then use Toxic Burst to trigger it now.

lessons.zhMechanism: 先积蓄力，再打重箭牌；消耗蓄力会触发牌上的追加效果。
lessons.enMechanism: Build Charge, then play a Heavy Arrow card to spend it on its bonus effect.

lessons.zhMechanism: 先挂持续伤害或破绽，再用重箭追击。留意消耗的蓄力。
lessons.enMechanism: Apply damage over time or Vulnerability, then follow with a Heavy Arrow.

lessons.zhMechanism: 首牌定阵赏；五张不同法师牌触发重放，雷阵按标记落雷。
lessons.enMechanism: First card sets the reward. Five different cards replay; Marks fuel lightning.

lessons.zhMechanism: 通用牌也计入五牌任务。按主动出牌顺序重放，不重复付费。
lessons.enMechanism: Core cards count too. Play five different cards; they replay in order for free.

lessons.zhMechanism: 火系牌开局决定阵赏；再主动打出另外四张不同法师牌。
lessons.enMechanism: Open with a Fire card to set its reward, then play four other Mage cards.

lessons.zhMechanism: 冰系牌开局决定阵赏；再主动打出另外四张不同法师牌。
lessons.enMechanism: Open with an Ice card to set its reward, then play four other Mage cards.

lessons.zhMechanism: 换成另一地势才算换场；地势收益按当前地形结算。
lessons.enMechanism: Switch to different terrain, then trigger a benefit from the new terrain.

lessons.zhMechanism: 根据攻防需要换地势，再多次触发收益；收益不会重放整张牌。
lessons.enMechanism: Choose terrain for attack or defense. Benefits trigger without replaying the card.

lessons.zhMechanism: 号令借最高攻击队友出手；再给受击队友护甲和反应。
lessons.enMechanism: Command calls your highest-ATK ally. Add Armor and reactions for defense.

lessons.zhMechanism: 先安排增益，再号令或誓约；合击由牌面指定的队友执行。
lessons.enMechanism: Prepare buffs, then command an attack. The card names which ally strikes.

lessons.zhMechanism: 首牌定阵赏；主动打出三张不同专属牌，免费依次重放。
lessons.enMechanism: First card sets the reward. Play three different personal cards for free replays.

lessons.zhMechanism: 每牌基础1气力；检索三张不同牌，衔接地势收益。
lessons.enMechanism: Cards cost 1 AP. Search for three different cards; trigger terrain benefits.

lessons.zhMechanism: 照夜做首牌；三张不同牌完成任务后，按标记逐次落雷。
lessons.enMechanism: Open with Night. Complete three different cards; Marks fuel its lightning.

lessons.zhMechanism: 对受伤队友出牌才有有效治疗；摹图再触发当前地势收益。
lessons.enMechanism: Heal an injured ally, then use Terrain to trigger the current terrain benefit.

lessons.zhMechanism: 先给敌人挂持续伤害，再用岩粉毒爆，立即结算伤害。
lessons.enMechanism: Apply damage over time, then use Seal for an immediate Toxic Burst.

lessons.zhMechanism: 先给高攻队友蓄力；重箭消耗牌面指定队友的蓄力。
lessons.enMechanism: Build Charge on your strongest ally. Heavy Arrow uses the named ally's Charge.

lessons.zhMechanism: 灵动有25%概率耗1层闪避，否则耗2层闪避；挡不住持续伤害。
lessons.enMechanism: Agility: 25% chance to dodge for 1 stack; otherwise needs 2. Cannot dodge DOT.

lessons.zhMechanism: 先挂持续伤害，再毒爆；转向受伤队友时使用治疗效果。
lessons.enMechanism: Apply damage over time, then Toxic Burst. Use healing on injured allies.

lessons.zhMechanism: 藤桥为队友积蓄力；山歌恢复全队气血，先看谁已受伤。
lessons.enMechanism: Vines builds ally Charge. Song restores party HP; check who is injured.
